worlds.name: Motion Valley
worlds.desc: A serene valley where objects dance with velocity and acceleration.

boss.name: Sir Isaac Newton
boss.title: Master of Motion
phrases: An object in motion stays in motion!
Can you solve my equations?
Every action has an equal and opposite reaction!

worlds.name: Force Forest
worlds.desc: A dense forest where every tree bends to Newton's three laws.

boss.name: Galileo Galilei
boss.title: Father of Observation
phrases: E pur si muove!
Measure what is measurable!
The universe is written in mathematics!

worlds.name: Gravity Mountains
worlds.desc: Towering peaks where gravity bends space and pulls everything downward.

boss.name: Albert Einstein
boss.title: Architect of Spacetime
phrases: Imagination is more important than knowledge!
Gravity is the curvature of spacetime.
God does not play dice!

worlds.name: Work & Energy Volcano
worlds.desc: A rumbling volcano converting potential energy into explosive kinetic power.

boss.name: James Prescott Joule
boss.title: Master of Energy
phrases: Energy cannot be created or destroyed!
Heat is a form of energy.
The living body is a heat engine!

worlds.name: Momentum Desert
worlds.desc: A vast desert where objects collide and momentum is conserved.

boss.name: Emmy Noether
boss.title: Symmetry Guardian
phrases: Symmetry implies conservation!
Every symmetry has a conservation law.
Mathematics is the purest form of thought!

worlds.name: Circular Motion Arena
worlds.desc: A colosseum where objects spin endlessly under centripetal force.

boss.name: Christiaan Huygens
boss.title: Lord of Centripetal Force
phrases: The center-seeking force governs all!
Time is the measure of motion.
Pendulums keep the world in rhythm!

worlds.name: Electric Kingdom
worlds.desc: A glowing kingdom crackling with charge, current, and electric fields.

boss.name: Michael Faraday
boss.title: Wizard of Electromagnetism
phrases: Nothing is too wonderful to be true!
Electricity is the soul of matter.
The force of gravity and electricity are linked!

worlds.name: Magnetism Temple
worlds.desc: An ancient temple where magnetic fields weave invisible forces.

boss.name: Nikola Tesla
boss.title: Master of Alternating Current
phrases: The present is theirs; the future is mine!
Current induces magnetic fields!
Let the future tell the truth!

worlds.name: Optics City
worlds.desc: A neon-lit city of lenses, mirrors, and prisms bending light at every corner.

boss.name: Christiaan Huygens
boss.title: Champion of Light
phrases: Light travels in waves!
Every point on a wavefront is a source!
Refraction reveals the medium!

worlds.name: Wave Ocean
worlds.desc: A vast ocean where transverse and longitudinal waves collide and superpose.

boss.name: Heinrich Hertz
boss.title: Prophet of Waves
phrases: The sparks prove the waves exist!
Frequency times wavelength equals speed!
One must not despise the day of small experiments!

worlds.name: Modern Physics Station
worlds.desc: A space station at the edge of reality, where classical physics breaks down.

boss.name: Marie Curie
boss.title: Guardian of Radioactivity
phrases: Nothing in life is to be feared, only understood!
Radium glows with atomic energy!
One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains!
